title: DD token overhead: MCP get payload is mostly duplicated text
body:
Measure before assuming retrieval volume or memory size is the cost. Retrieval rarely injects (98% abstain, 1.17 memories per injection). The waste is in MCP get: of ~7 KB per atom, ~4.2 KB is exact duplication (retrieval_forms repeats behavior_delta+why three times, what copies behavior_delta, evidence_state repeats evidence_refs plus hashes). Remove duplicates from model-facing output instead of shortening authored content; shortening micro forms loses scope/conditions and saves little.

Why: Per-field breakdown of the 34 active atoms on 2026-09-22: retrieval_forms 2789 B, evidence_state 777 B, what 671 B, versus behavior_delta 674 B, evidence_refs 469 B, why 394 B. Telemetry in ~/.dd-data/supermem-*/index.sqlite: 1118 retrievals, 23 non-abstained. retrieve.js already notes compact forms cannot remove the scope that makes advice valid.

evidence.summary: deriveForms builds micro/short/full from behavior_delta and why; normalizeProposal sets what = behavior_delta
get returns the full atom verbatim via jsonResult
avg bytes: retrieval_forms 2789, evidence_state 777, behavior_delta 674, what 671, evidence_refs 469, why 394

revisit_when.description: form derivation or what field changes

v1.trigger: When investigating DD token cost, JSON overhead, or proposing to shrink memories/forms to save tokens
